summary: Baronet and MP for Cheltenham 1847–48; John's 5th cousin 6x removed.
bio: Path: Capt. Effingham Lawrence → Catharine Maria (m. Sir John Thomas Jones, 1st Bt) → Willoughby. His deaf daughter Maud drew Alexander Graham Bell's interest. Brother Sir Lawrence Jones, 2nd Bt, baronet and travel writer, murdered in Turkey 1845 (5C6R). Son Rt. Rev. Herbert Jones, Bishop of Lewes (6C5R).
